rules: earliest_available_date is the current Los Angeles calendar date plus seven calendar days
a fully specified requested date before earliest_available_date is TOO_SOON
a fully specified requested date on or after earliest_available_date is AVAILABLE
there is no maximum future booking horizon
a monthless day such as 27th must produce ASK_CLARIFICATION unless an authoritative immediately preceding scheduling turn supplies the month
absence from close_booking_options_local is never evidence of unavailability
the model may phrase a decision but may not decide date legality or availability
pure social conversation does not enter the tattoo funnel
one concrete subject motif grounded reference or subject bounded creative freedom is enough design authority to offer the form
a compliment capability question placement or size alone is not design authority
placement and exact size are decided in person and are not required booking gates
once design authority exists do not reopen an abstract design interview
a missing referent or missing attachment must be clarified before funnel advancement
a reference source need not already look like a finished tattoo

required_progression: name and phone used on form
forbidden: empty reply for valid unsuppressed inbound
inventing a business rule or unavailable date
answering only part of a compound direct question
repeating form offer form link double check or deposit handoff without explicit resend or correction
allowing a rejected candidate to mutate adopted state
conversation_progression_policy.verifier_failure_policy: one model reauthor then route bounded deterministic recovery
